rationale: The GuardDuty containment function must call IAM, which has no VPC endpoint. Placing it in the VPC would require a NAT gateway (an egress path the boundary deliberately lacks) and gain no security benefit. Compensating controls: least-privilege execution role scoped to user/* and containment actions only, FIPS endpoints, X-Ray tracing, KMS-encrypted environment and dead-letter queue.

The lab distribution uses the default *.cloudfront.net certificate, for which CloudFront pins the minimum protocol to TLSv1. The code switches to TLSv1.2_2021 as soon as acm_certificate_arn is set; a custom domain is planned before the assessment. Compensating controls: HTTPS redirect, HSTS with preload, no CUI served from the origin.

The S3 server access logging target bucket cannot log to itself (recursion) and AWS does not support SSE-KMS on access-log targets. It contains request metadata only and is protected by Object Ownership enforced, public access block, TLS-only policy and lifecycle.
Root hardware MFA on the lab accounts is pending; root is denied by SCP in member accounts and alarmed on use. Tracked for completion before the assessment.
